fixed.explanation: Worker targets are attached in FrameSession._onAttachedToTarget, which never sends locale emulation to the worker session. I added Emulation.setLocaleOverride, using emulateLocale, and Emulation.setUserAgentOverride with acceptLanguage when the context has a locale. Workers now get the same locale for navigator.languages and for the Accept-Language header.

query.intent: When a dedicated web worker target is attached in the Chromium page/context code, apply the locale emulation to the worker session, e.g. send Emulation.setLocaleOverride (and Accept-Language via Network.setUserAgentOverride) to the worker's CDP session, just as is done for pages.
query.symptom: Dedicated web workers in Chromium ignore the browser context's locale, so their requests' Accept-Language and navigator.languages remain English.

history.analysis: emulateLocale and _updateUserAgent apply locale only to page sessions. The worker attach code (the handler for Target.attachedToTarget with type 'worker' in FrameSession) isn't visible yet. It likely creates a Worker and could send the locale override and user agent override to the worker session.

query.intent: Code in FrameSession that handles Target.attachedToTarget for worker targets, creating a Worker with a CRSession and running worker setup commands (Runtime.enable, Network.enable, etc.).
